name: The noun of instrument (ism al-āla)
definition: A noun for the tool with which an action is done, on the patterns mifʿal, mifʿāl and mifʿala: miftāḥ, 'key', from fataḥa.
body: It is made from a three-letter transitive verb with a kasra on the mīm: minṣar (an instrument of help, the example of the Ottoman primers), miftāḥ (key), and others heard on other patterns. Al-Amthila and al-ʿIzzī list it among the forms derived from each verb.

examples.text: minṣar, the instrument of naṣara in al-Amthila.
